subject: Post-demo: context & costing — request for average prompt/completion numbers
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Blake Turner <blake@coralanalytics.com>, Eve Ward <eve.ward@coralanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: context & costing — request for average prompt/completion numbers

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great discussion. As promised, we want to nail the cost model for Coral before a follow-up pilot proposal. Quick ask so our pricing is aligned with your usage patterns: can you share typical distributions for the three items below for the top 3 product flows you expect to put on Redwood?

- average prompt tokens per request (incl. system + user)
- average completion tokens per request (expected returned output)
- what percent of requests need 8k / 32k / 128k context windows (approx)

We captured rough examples in the attached sample_sessions CSV; feel free to paste or point to a small query export and we'll transform. Target is to propose a $/1M-token band and a pilot budget.

High-level assumptions we will use if you don’t have exact numbers yet:
- baseline mix: 70% short (<=2k prompt, <=500 completion), 25% mid (<=8k prompt, <=1k completion), 5% long (>8k prompt or >8k completion)
- estimated unit cost target you mentioned: ~$200 per 1M tokens for production SLA — we’ll show lower and higher unit scenarios.

Next steps we propose: you share a 2-week sample or a few typical session rows by EOD Friday; we’ll return an itemized cost worksheet and a proposed pilot SOW within 2 business days.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

From: Blake Turner <blake@coralanalytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Eve Ward <eve.ward@coralanalytics.com>

Date: 2026-12-18T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: context & costing — request for average prompt/completion numbers

Thanks, Sofia — appreciate the clarity. Quick answers from our ops team (attaching CSV extract). Summary by flow: 

- "Insight Summaries" (search -> summary): avg prompt tokens 1,200; avg completion tokens 600; windows: 95% use 8k, ~5% escalate to 32k for long docs.
- "Client Reports" (batch generate): avg prompt tokens 9,500 (includes uploaded doc text), avg completion tokens 1,200; windows: 75% need 32k, 25% need 128k in rare regulatory runs.
- "Conversational Assist" (chat UI): avg prompt tokens 600; avg completion tokens 350; windows: 100% fit 8k.

Budget / unit economics note: Our finance lead said target production spend is $15k–$25k / month for the pilot; we want to see a proposal that hits ~ $150–$225 per 1M tokens depending on SLA and retention. We can share a small sample export (s3 link) if that helps.

Blake Turner
Head of Product | Coral Analytics
blake@coralanalytics.com

Attachment: coral_sample_sessions.csv (3 rows)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T14:18:00-08:00
Subject: internal: quick sizing math for Coral (do not forward)

Sofia / Vanessa — quick internal calc based on Blake's numbers (rounded):
- Flow breakdown estimate (weighting): Insight Summaries 60%, Client Reports 30%, Conversational Assist 10%
- Weighted avg prompt tokens ≈ (0.6*1200)+(0.3*9500)+(0.1*600) = 3,360 prompt tokens/request
- Weighted avg completion tokens ≈ (0.6*600)+(0.3*1200)+(0.1*350) = 735 completion tokens/request
- If pilot target is 100k requests/month -> total tokens = 100k*(3,360+735)=~409.5M tokens/month
- At target $150 per 1M tokens -> monthly = 409.5 * 0.15 = ~$61k (outside their $25k ceiling). At $225 per 1M -> ~$92k/month.

Key levers to get under $25k for pilot: reduce request count (sampling), aggressive batching & prefix caching for uploaded docs, commit to a reserved capacity discount, and push some heavy batch report generation to off-peak (cheaper tier).

Action: Sofia to surface these numbers in an external-friendly way and propose two pilot options (lite + standard) with concrete token bands, expected monthly cost range, and recommended platform controls (batching/cache/quantization).

-Karthik
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-demo: context & costing — request for average prompt/completion numbers

Blake / Eve — thanks for the quick data. We put together two short pilot options (attached PDF):

1) Pilot Lite — 25k requests/month
   - Assumes 75% insight / 20% reports / 5% chat mix
   - Expected tokens/mo: ~102M -> cost band $15k–$23k depending on SLA & quantization (matches your upper range)
   - Includes basic caching and batching recommendations, up to 32k context for report generation (burst).

2) Pilot Standard — 100k requests/month
   - Assumes your provided mix
   - Expected tokens/mo: ~410M -> cost band $60k–$95k depending on SLA and reserved capacity discounts
   - Adds scheduled off-peak batch window for heavy 128k runs, 2-week rollout, and telemetry hooks for quality/regression checks.

Requested next steps:
- Please confirm which pilot you'd like to proceed with (Lite or Standard) and whether your team can commit to a small reserved capacity for reports (helps unit economics).
- If you want tighter numbers, share a 7–14 day event export (CSV or S3 link) and we’ll run a tokenization pass and send a final pilot SOW.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_breakdown_v2.pdf (pilot options + cost bands)

Best,
Sofia
